Thank you for your offer.

We currently have a sufficient setup in place, and our methodology is already quite advanced. Introducing an overlapping device could introduce inconsistencies in our data readings and create unnecessary risk.

For these reasons, we don't believe this solution would be relevant for us at this stage.

Thanks again for reaching out.

Best regards,
